title: Exposure
description: Canonical exposure record schema for randomized treatment assignment among eligible customers.

exposure_id.description: Unique identifier for this exposure record.

customer_id.description: Foreign key referencing the eligible customer.

eligible.description: Eligibility indicator: strictly true for rows in this exposure table.

treatment.description: Randomized treatment assignment: 1 for treated (offer received), 0 for control.

assignment_probability.description: Known randomized assignment probability (strictly 0.5 for unbiased ATE/Qini estimation).

assigned_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp representing the exact assignment time at campaign start.
